scope: This composes the scale-ratio classification, signed CM partner geometry, two-member character projector, and CM norm. It still assumes the transformed point relations and the exact duplicated-versus-separated character classification; it does not construct the original Semaev relation, prove torsion-to-division-polynomial vanishing, construct the specialized polynomial, or establish subexponential ECDLP runtime.
statement: For the A equals zero short curve, a square-product collision of two distinct scaled cubic radicands, two corresponding lifted affine points, and a size-two duplicated sign-character class construct a nonidentity cubic CM ratio and an explicit Eisenstein norm that annihilates the chosen point.
